messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am new to Deducer. I would like to have guidance on the following issue, and I hope not to pose a question already asked.
When I try to import my dataset frm an Excel file, I got an error message saying that there is no package called "XLConnect". I guess that it is for this reason that the command "ReadWorksheet" is not found.
I tried to search for that package but I do not manage to find it. Is it not available any more?

I am using R 2.15.1, JGR 1.7-11, MAC SnowLeopard.

Thanks for any hint you will kindly provide,
Best Regards
Gianmarco

messages.subject_clean: not able to load data from Excel file
messages.body_plain:
Due to some issues with the CRAN repository, only the "source"
distribution of that package is available. type:

install.packages("XLConnect", type = "source")

to install.

best,
Ian

Em quarta-feira, 22 de agosto de 2012 22h16min39s UTC-3, Ian escreveu:
> Hi JD,
>
> I can't remember if the "color by" option was removed for Deducer
> 0.6-3, but it will be removed for version 0.7-0 due out on the third.
> The templates are designed to be the simplest possible interface to
> get standard plots. To create more colorful/rich plots, the grammar of
> graphics is the way to go.
>
> try building you histogram like you usually do, and the right click on
> "histogram" in the component list on the right. Select "Break out." If
> you now double click it, it will show you all of the histogram options
> under the hood. drag a variable into "colour" and you will have your
> stacked histogram.
>
>
> ian
